input: Get a sports massage after the charity run

gold.taskTitle: Book a sports massage after the charity run
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to arrange a sports massage following their participation in a charity run.

questions.title: What is the exact date of the charity run?
questions.description: Establish the run date to time the massage booking correctly.

questions.title: How soon after the run do you want the massage?
questions.description: Determine whether the massage should be same-day, next-day, or within a few days post-run.

questions.title: Do you already have a preferred therapist or clinic?
questions.description: Find out if the user has an existing go-to provider or needs one found.

questions.title: What city or neighbourhood should the massage be in?
questions.description: Identify the location so a nearby provider can be selected.

questions.title: What duration do you want for the session?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a 30-, 60-, or 90-minute massage.

questions.title: Is there a budget limit you want to stay within?
questions.description: Understand any price constraints to filter suitable providers.

questions.title: Are there any injury or focus areas to tell the therapist?
questions.description: Capture specific physical needs such as tight calves, a sore knee, or lower back tension.
